scope: Shared route selector; refine H1 before H2; reuse across all lands.

difficulty.key: semantic tier from reviewed content, never array index or environment name
difficulty.note: Project design proposal, not a convention proven by the cited games. No third shipped route is added.

card.layout: Shared role tracks for cards in a row; track height follows longest content; allow growth and reflow.
forbid: nested interactive controls inside a card button

selected: aria-pressed when a toggle button is used
completed: separate activity-completion label; does not claim mastery
locked: short prerequisite reason at affected activity

text.fullJustification: avoid for narrow short route descriptions; not a universal Persian ban
text.mixedDirection: isolate known LTR runs with dir; unknown inserted runs with bdi/dir=auto; preserve logical order
text.summary: one action/objective; move supporting detail after selection without hiding essential progression meaning
text.letterSpacing: do not apply Latin spacing recipes to joined Persian without review

map.fork: visible connections from shared arrival to every destination
map.identity: retain environment identity in selected, completed and locked states

assetPolicy: Use existing approved assets or original art; third-party screenshots are source references only.

checks: long Persian title and aligned role tracks
keyboard focus and logical reading order
child identifies difficulty, selection, completion and switching without coaching
verifiedChecks: four reordered fixture routes with semantic color and neutral unknown tier
only unmet prerequisites in lock reason

evidenceLimits: No game session or child study performed.
Console screenshots do not validate phone usability.
Sackboy source is the designer personal portfolio.
H1 selector refined; live output remains unchanged.
copyReviewStatus: owner-requested-revision; existing technical checks do not close typography/copy review
